notes: Added incremental stories to strengthen API contract enforcement, core ranking logic, and integration coverage.

FEAT-1-STORY-075.title: Enforce location normalization and validation in provider search schema
FEAT-1-STORY-075.description: Enhance provider search request models to normalize and validate location inputs (ZIP, city, state) and ensure compatibility with FIPS/county mapping used downstream.

FEAT-1-STORY-076.title: Implement ranking and fallback blending logic
FEAT-1-STORY-076.description: Refine provider_search_service to blend vector search scores with taxonomy fallback results, ensuring deterministic ranking and graceful degradation when embeddings underperform.

FEAT-1-STORY-077.title: Expose provider search via FastAPI endpoint
FEAT-1-STORY-077.description: Ensure provider search is accessible through the FastAPI entrypoint, correctly wired through tool_router and returning structured responses for frontend consumption.

FEAT-1-STORY-078.title: Add edge case and failure mode tests for provider search
FEAT-1-STORY-078.description: Expand test coverage to include empty results, invalid inputs, embedding failures, and fallback-only scenarios to ensure system resilience.
